title: Mold Protocol Figure — Insurance Claim Services Pricing Clause
content:
**Clause.** The protocol figure of an Insurance Claim Services mold protocol supplement is the core scope plus each scope family it carries, every family priced from the growth area recorded on the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance and that job tier's rates; the sum is held to the mold room and rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure (tolerance 1e-09 added before rounding).

- **Core scope:** the growth area multiplied by the sum of the tier's HEPA vacuuming rate and antimicrobial rate per square foot.
- **Surface treatment:** wire-brush sanding and encapsulation of the growth area — the growth area multiplied by the sum of the tier's two rates per square foot.
- **Removal:** drywall removal and insulation removal over the growth area — the growth area multiplied by the sum of the tier's two rates per square foot.
- **Air treatment:** one dehumidifier for the tier's billable equipment day cap at the tier's dehumidifier daily rate.
- **Mold room:** the file's mold sublimit less the mold amounts already approved on the file, never below zero; the protocol figure may not exceed it.

## Worked figure (hypothetical rates and area)

Growth area 140 square feet; HEPA 0.80 and antimicrobial 0.65 per square foot; wire-brush sanding 1.10 and encapsulation 0.90; drywall removal 1.35 and insulation removal 0.75; dehumidifier 85.00 a day with a 3-day cap.

| Family | Amount |
|---|---|
| core scope: 140 multiplied by 1.45 | 203.00 |
| surface treatment: 140 multiplied by 2.00 | 280.00 |
| removal: 140 multiplied by 2.10 | 294.00 |
| air treatment: 85.00 multiplied by 3 | 255.00 |
| sum | 1032.00 |

With a mold sublimit of 10000.00 and 2650.00 already approved, the room is 7350.00 and the figure is **1032.00**. With 9200.00 already approved, the room is 800.00 and the figure is held to **800.00**.
